nbs_consumption.admitted_use: Q2 historical aggregate targets and initial aggregate magnitude; not hourly supply, sector service or physical fuel LHV
nbs_consumption.restriction: Primary electricity and other energy is the published category; it is not automatically nonfossil consumption. No NBS/OWID accounting splice.

nbs_capacity.admitted_use: Q2 year-end aggregate capacity targets; source unit 10^4 kW; multiply by 10 to MW
nbs_capacity.restriction: Thermal is not coal alone; hydro includes unspecified pumped component; year-end stock is not full-year available capacity; no implied age/permit/queue.

nbs_gdp.admitted_use: Q2 exogenous realized GDP growth driver, never an energy-behavior calibration target
nbs_gdp.restriction: Already-seen conditional hindcast. Do not mix with table 3-4 silently; this limited subset alone cannot compound a 2005-2024 index.

btr_co2.locator: Table 1-4a; physical PDF pages 30-31, printed pages 20-21; CO2 columns only; table notes on physical page 32
btr_co2.admitted_use: Q2 historical CO2 boundary checks; sparse net-flux anchors; memoir emissions remain outside inventory totals
btr_co2.restriction: No CH4/N2O/CO2e mixing. LULUCF is a net sector flux, not gross engineered removal capacity. No 2024-2060 sink path follows from these three observations. Do not splice with GCB without boundary reconciliation.
